scope: Bounded source-to-artist review of qualified narrow-size design only; no native integration or repeated preparation/reuse audit.

interpretation: Profiles are normalized by each own basal contrast; the map does not display incumbent concentration differences.

Spring resting size and actual basal circumference are both shown; fixed material centres have initial physical offsets and later stretch withC(t).
